mapper.select: SELECT T.memberid, T.method, DATE_FORMAT(T.regdate, '%H:%i') regdate FROM ( SELECT memberid, max(attendanceid) as attendanceid FROM ttokssaemdb.attendance WHERE branchid = #{session_branchid} AND regdate > STR_TO_DATE(#{lastdate}, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') GROUP BY memberid ) A, ttokssaemdb.attendance T, ttokssaemdb.member M WHERE A.attendanceid = T.attendanceid AND T.memberid = M.memberid AND M.classyn = 'Y'

SELECT m.memberid, rp.method, rp.hour, rp.minute, rp.status FROM ttokssaemdb.member AS m LEFT JOIN ttokssaemdb.runtimeplan AS rp ON rp.memberid = m.memberid AND rp.branchid = m.branchid AND rp.dayofweek = ${dayofweek} AND rp.status <> 3 AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ttokssaemdb.runtimeplan r2 WHERE r2.memberid = rp.memberid AND r2.branchid = rp.branchid AND r2.dayofweek = rp.dayofweek AND r2.status <> 3 AND r2.sortorder < rp.sortorder ) < 2 WHERE m.branchid = #{branchid} AND m.type = 'S' AND m.classyn = 'Y' ORDER BY m.membername ASC, rp.sortorder ASC

SELECT memberid, method, hour, minute, status FROM ttokssaemdb.runtimeplan WHERE branchid = #{branchid} AND dayofweek = ${dayofweek} AND memberid = #{memberid} AND status <> 3 ORDER BY sortorder LIMIT 2

SELECT 'Attendance' as tt, CASE WHEN method = 0 THEN '입실' ELSE '퇴실' END as title, DATE_FORMAT(min(regdate), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as start, 'false' as allDay FROM ttokssaemdb.attendance WHERE memberid = #{memberid} AND regdate BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY regdate
